mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS falling for 3 consecutive months) signals monetary easing, compressing discount rates and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods of sustained FEDFUNDS decline are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 5.0% signals restrictive monetary policy, increasing discount rates and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate below 3.5% signals a tight labor market, supporting strong consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE falls below 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous positive quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) and rising monthly housing starts (HOUST) indicate robust consumer demand, driving equity valuations higher and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when both GDPC1 growth exceeds 0.5% and HOUST growth exceeds 0.3%.

mechanism_narrative: In a high industrial production cycle (INDPRO > 105), strong manufacturing output supports corporate profit growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO exceeds 105.

mechanism_narrative: A low CPIAUCSL (inflation rate) relative to the 10-year average reduces real interest rate uncertainty, supporting equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low CPIAUCSL periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL inflation rate above 3.5% signals persistent inflation, prompting central bank rate hikes and increasing discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Strong employment growth (PAYEMS growth > 0.5%) combined with low unemployment (UNRATE < 3.8%) indicates a healthy labor market, boosting consumer confidence and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS growth exceeds 0.5% and UNRATE falls below 3.8%.
